title: Business Central 2025 wave 2 (BC27): TextConst Data Type now have manipulation methods (Contains, ToUpper, Replace, etc.)
summary: Business Central 2025 wave 2 (BC27) introduces manipulation methods for the TextConst data type, enabling string operations like Contains, Replace, ToUpper, Split, and Trim. These methods are available in runtime version 15.1 or greater.
key_points: TextConst data type now supports 20+ string manipulation methods for operations on text constants
Common methods include Contains, StartsWith, EndsWith, Replace, Split, and case conversion functions
Methods for string searching include IndexOf, LastIndexOf, and IndexOfAny with optional position parameters
Text formatting methods available: PadLeft, PadRight, Remove, Trim, TrimStart, and TrimEnd
Runtime version 15.1 or greater required; Contains is not available in version 15.0

quotes.text: With this wave (BC27), Microsoft added manipulation methods for this data type.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes that this is a new feature in BC27 specifically for TextConst data type

quotes.text: These methods are supported in runtime version '15.1' (Business Central 2025 release wave 1 Update 26.1) or greater.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the minimum runtime version requirement for developers implementing these methods
